mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS on 20-day returns is below 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window, or average 20-day return during FEDFUNDS declines is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 5.0%, it indicates a tight labor market that typically precedes stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of UNRATE < 5.0% instances, 5-day forward returns are negative, or Rank IC for UNRATE is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust economic expansion, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction effect between GDPC1 and HOUST is insignificant (p > 0.05) in 60-day return regression, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation environments (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 60% of CPIAUCSL > 3.0% periods, 20-day forward returns are positive, or Rank IC for CPIAUCSL in high inflation regimes is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong manufacturing output, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for INDPRO on 5-day returns is below 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window, or average 5-day return during INDPRO increases is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When monthly payroll employment gains (PAYEMS) exceed 200,000, it signals a strong labor market that typically precedes corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of PAYEMS > 200000 instances, 20-day forward returns are negative, or Rank IC for PAYEMS is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer and housing demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction effect between RSAFS and HOUST is insignificant (p > 0.05) in 60-day return regression, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In low industrial production growth regimes (INDPRO growth rate < 0.5% year-over-year), supply constraints lead to higher inflation and monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 60% of low INDPRO growth periods (growth rate < 0.5%), 20-day forward returns are positive, or Rank IC for INDPRO in low growth regimes is below 0.03.
